Annual prizes for Broadway plays and musicals, co-presented by the League and the Wing.

How Tony Awards connects

  • Topic: Broadway — The Tony Awards are Broadway's annual prizes.
  • Faction: The Broadway League — The Broadway League co-presents the Tony Awards.
  • Work: Hamilton — Hamilton swept the 2016 Tony Awards.
  • Work: The Book of Mormon — The Book of Mormon won Best Musical at the Tony Awards.

What is Tony Awards?

The Antoinette Perry Awards — the Tonys — are the June ceremony that crowns Broadway's best play, musical, and performances, jointly presented by the Broadway League and the American Theatre Wing.

Key threads lead to Broadway, The Broadway League, Hamilton and The Book of Mormon.
